author: Myv
body:
ORIGINAL POST: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/2b61e4594

I have improved my original map, Blocked, from the feedback given and my own personal preference and I feel I have a much better version now, though there is still a huge chance it can be improved.

ORIGINAL ALBUM: http://imgur.com/a/fYzYO
UPDATED ALBUM: http://imgur.com/a/O2KJO

As well as design changes, the diamond in the iron above spawn has been removed, and there are only 5 blocks of diamond in the mid, meaning use of it will need to be much more carefully consumed.

Map Information

Creators: Myv
Server Hosted: alexanderjoe
Team Colours: Cyan and Lime
Team Sizes: 12v12 (UPDATED)
Time Limit: 15 minutes

Other Information

Download: Yet to be done
XML: Will be done if necessary.

NOTE: The loadout/kit for each team is included in the images.

Thank you for viewing my map and feel free to leave feedback below.

Myv
